mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sh.pay_amount), 0) FROM saving_history sh JOIN saving_account sa ON sh.account_id = sa.account_id WHERE sa.user_id = #{userId} AND sa.del_yn = 'N' AND sh.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT u.name, mr.rank_name, mt.type_name, u.unit_name, u.enlist_date, u.discharge_date FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN military_rank mr ON u.rank_id = mr.rank_id LEFT JOIN military_types mt ON u.type_id = mt.type_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.del_yn = 'N'
SELECT discharge_date FROM user WHERE id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT account_id AS accountId, user_id AS userId, bank_code AS bankCode, monthly_save AS monthlySave, monthly_count AS monthlyCount, curr_amount AS currAmount, account_status AS accountStatus, open_date AS openDate FROM saving_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N'
SELECT history_id, account_id, pay_round, pay_amount, paid_date FROM saving_history WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY pay_round ASC

SELECT vacation_id AS vacationId, user_id AS userId, vacation_cate AS vacationCate, vacation_name AS vacationName, vacation_get AS vacationGet, vacation_day AS vacationDay FROM vacation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY vacation_get DESC

SELECT vacation_id AS vacationId, user_id AS userId, vacation_cate AS vacationCate, vacation_name AS vacationName, vacation_get AS vacationGet, vacation_day AS vacationDay FROM vacation WHERE vacation_id = #{vacationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vacation ( user_id, vacation_cate, vacation_name, vacation_get, vacation_day, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{vacationCate}, #{vacationName}, #{vacationGet}, #{vacationDay}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE vacation SET vacation_cate = #{vacationCate}, vacation_name = #{vacationName}, vacation_get = #{vacationGet}, vacation_day = #{vacationDay}, modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE vacation_id = #{vacationId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT history_id AS historyId, vacation_id AS vacationId, used_date AS usedDate, used_day AS usedDay FROM vacation_history WHERE vacation_id = #{vacationId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY used_date ASC

SELECT vh.history_id AS historyId, vh.vacation_id AS vacationId, vh.used_date AS usedDate, vh.used_day AS usedDay FROM vacation_history vh JOIN vacation v ON v.vacation_id = vh.vacation_id WHERE vh.history_id = #{historyId} AND v.user_id = #{userId} AND vh.del_yn = 'N' AND v.del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vacation_history ( vacation_id, used_date, used_day, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{vacationId}, #{usedDate}, #{usedDay}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
